sections.html: This very unusual loricariid was imported from Brazil in a small number.

Technically, these fish belong to the species P. aurantiacus. The species is famous for the fact that it can be bright golden, marbled or black in colour, and it is documented that it can change colour in a comparatively short time. This phenomenon was also observed in the specimens described here.

The fish were 8-12 cm long at the time. The photographed specimens are males and had already reached full maturity.
